scope: Switch 2 (S2Arm) private test IPA only, never the common IPA, chained after the S2Arm probe review: the root pubspec.yaml gains the workspace member and the path dependency of the local plugin packages/s2arm_engine_bridge (RewindBox host code of the embedded engine under the repository licence: method channel, game preparation, JIT helper session, code pages, launch journal and pack plan, Objective-C and C, linked statically into Runner; the pod needs Apple's Foundation, UIKit and Security). Its podspec vendors Frameworks/S2ArmPrepare.xcframework, which is never committed (the package .gitignore ignores ios/Frameworks/): the test line delivery downloads it from its authenticated producer run of .github/workflows/s2arm-core.yml and unzips it there before CocoaPods. It is built by build-utils/s2arm/build_prepare_xcframework.sh from native/s2arm/prepare (RewindBox ports of S2Arm tools, repository licence, Apache-2.0 notice of S2Arm kept) with the S2Arm rewriter (Apache-2.0), Capstone 5.0.7 (BSD-3-Clause, LLVM-derived parts under the LLVM Release License) and LZ4 1.9.4 as bundled by python-lz4 4.4.5 (BSD-2-Clause), at the pins of tools/s2arm_prototype/pin.json. No hosted package, engine, Core or vendored native source of this tree changes; pubspec.lock is unchanged (a workspace member is not listed there). The engine frameworks and the system data the test IPA also ships are delivery components authenticated by the launcher (docs/s2arm-engine-bridge.md), not declarations of this tree; their notices are drafted in docs/s2arm-legal-notices.md for the integration owner.
